Distribution. Stephanodiscus makarovae was observed downstream from Mykolaiv city in the Southern Bug River (Table 1). It was observed in the Dnipro River and its reservoirs, the Danube River and in the coastal area of the Black Sea (Genkal et al. 2009; Tsarenko et al. 2009; Genkal and Terenko 2014). As for general distribution, this taxon has only a few records around the world - Europe (Russia, Ukraine), Asia (Armenia, Russia), Africa (Egypt) (Kulikovskiy et al. 2016; Genkal et al. 2020).
